note: Hot final parse of a strict 10KB, 24-item JSON reply. json5.loads takes the whole ~62ms; stdlib json.loads on the same bytes is well under 1ms, with json5 kept as the fallback for comments, single quotes, and trailing commas.

Default incremental path still runs for this 609-character reply (under the 1024-char deferral). Each 24-character chunk re-runs json5.loads on the whole buffer, then finalize parses it again. A strict-JSON fast path, or not reparsing a stable prefix, saves far more than 10ms.
yaml_literal replies call yaml.safe_load, the pure-Python SafeLoader, even when yaml.CSafeLoader is importable. This 180-item fenced document is ~55ms; the same body through CSafeLoader is about 5ms.

Every structured response rebuilds a Pydantic model per clause, including a fresh citations model of the same shape 96 times. Reusing identical nested models, or caching the declaration, removes well over 10ms from this ~70ms call.
Composite file references miss the alias index, so each of 40 claims re-runs anchor regex across all 160 ledger items. Normalizing anchors once per ledger removes most of this ~94ms guard pass.
